parts.label: (a)
parts.part_stem: A sphere in a liquid accelerates vertically downwards from rest. For the viscous force acting on the moving sphere, state:

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: the variation, if any, in the magnitude.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
A man of weight $750\text{ N}$ stands a distance of $3.6\text{ m}$ from end D of a horizontal uniform beam AD, as shown in Fig. 4.1.
{{figure:figure_4_1}}
Fig. 4.1 (not to scale)
The beam has a weight of $380\text{ N}$ and a length of $9.0\text{ m}$. The beam is supported by a vertical force $F_{\text{B}}$ at pivot B and a vertical force $F_{\text{C}}$ at pivot C. Pivot B is a distance of $2.0\text{ m}$ from end A and pivot C is a distance of $2.0\text{ m}$ from end D. The beam is in equilibrium.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: By using moments about pivot C, calculate $F_{\text{B}}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The man walks towards end D. The beam is about to tip when $F_{\text{B}}$ becomes zero.
Determine the minimum distance $x$ from end D that the man can stand without tipping the beam.
